canDoYue: 你識趕急刻金手鈪、普通刻字趕得切星期六婚禮、傍晚先睇校對稿，同埋問急單收費。
canDoEn: Ask to rush gold-bracelet lettering before Saturday morning, hear that plain lettering finishes in time for the wedding, check one proof that evening, and ask the rush fee for one change.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Could you rush the lettering on this gold bracelet before Saturday morning?
dialogue.glossYue: 星期六朝早之前可唔可以趕急刻字喺呢隻金手鈪？
dialogue.say: Could you rush the lettering on this gold bracelet before Saturday morning?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: I can start that lettering this afternoon, and the piece will be ready.
dialogue.glossYue: 我可以今日下晝開始刻字，件貨會做好。
dialogue.say: I can start that lettering this afternoon, and the piece will be ready.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Will plain lettering finish in time if the wedding stays on Saturday?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果婚禮係星期六，普通刻字趕唔趕得切？
dialogue.say: Will plain lettering finish in time if the wedding stays on Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: The wedding can stay on Saturday, and the work finishes Friday.
dialogue.glossYue: 婚禮可以照星期六，工作星期五做完。
dialogue.say: The wedding can stay on Saturday, and the work finishes Friday.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Can I see one proof of the words before you cut the bracelet?
dialogue.glossYue: 切手鈪之前，可唔可以畀我睇一次校對稿？
dialogue.say: Can I see one proof of the words before you cut the bracelet?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: I will email that proof this evening, before the cut.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會喺傍晚電郵嗰份校對稿，切之前交。
dialogue.say: I will email that proof this evening, before the cut.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: What is the rush fee if that proof needs one small change?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果校對稿要改少少，急單收費幾多？
dialogue.say: What is the rush fee if that proof needs one small change?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: The rush fee is eighty dollars, and one proof change is free.
dialogue.glossYue: 急單收費八十蚊，改一次校對稿免費。
dialogue.say: The rush fee is eighty dollars, and one proof change is free.
